text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> is performing well, and it's only a matter of time until she earns the right to enter the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the increased attention results in a bogus news article. It becomes a major incident, with reporters knocking at the gates of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The director proposes temporarily restricting media access to the academy, but reconsiders after hearing Reporter Otonashi's passionate plea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an effort to quell the misconceptions surrounding me, Reporter Otonashi plans a new article titled Up Close and Personal with Trainer !
